executed.description: True only if you actually read the role's command body and performed it. False if anything stopped you before that — a missing file, a refused read, a precondition you could not meet.

outcome.description: The run's own terminal token. Use the token the command body derives; never grade yourself.

reason.description: Empty when the outcome is ok. Otherwise the single word or short phrase naming what stopped or withheld it.

report.description: The run's own report block, verbatim.
